declarations.name: TheoremOS.FiniteMatrixFirstMoment.summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization
declarations.type: ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {c : ℕ → ℝ} {L R : ℕ → ι → ℝ}, (∀ n i, 0 ≤ L n i) → (∀ n i, 0 ≤ R n i) → (∀ a b, c (a + b) = ∑ i, L a i * R b i) → Summable c → Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * c n)

declarations.name: TheoremOS.FiniteMatrixFirstMoment.summable_matrix_firstMoment
declarations.type: ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (u v : ι → ℝ), (∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ v i) → Summable (matrixMass A u v) → Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * matrixMass A u v n)

matrixMassDefinition: matrixMass A u v n = u ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ n) *ᵥ v)
